faq.question: How quickly can my intake specialist start?
faq.answer: Once we've had our consultation call and confirmed the match, your specialist will be fully onboarded and ready to handle intake within **72 business hours**. We handle all briefing and setup — you just introduce them to your tools.

faq.question: How bilingual are they, really?
faq.answer: All YVA professionals are **fully fluent in English and Spanish** — not conversational, fully fluent. They can handle sensitive client conversations, explain legal procedures, and gather detailed case information in both languages without missing anything.

faq.question: What CRM and tools do they use?
faq.answer: Your specialist adapts to **whatever tools your firm already uses** — Clio, MyCase, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Workspace, Slack, and more. There's no switching, no disruption to your existing workflow.

faq.question: Is there a contract or minimum commitment?
faq.answer: We have a service agreement but **no long-term lock-in**. You can exit at any time with no penalties. We believe our results should be the reason you stay — not a contract.

faq.question: What if the specialist isn't a good fit?
faq.answer: Just let us know and we'll **match you with someone else at no extra cost**. We're committed to finding the right fit for your firm — not just filling a seat.
